lines.zh: 我收放身体，在水里前进。
lines.en: I squeeze and release to move through the water.

lines.zh: 触腕朝后一推，我就走了。
lines.en: A push from my arms and I'm off.
No glow of mine; I feel the water instead.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥沙游，几乎看不出来。
lines.en: I swim close to the silt, nearly invisible.
A twist of the body and I change course.
I glide over a sunken log.
The current pushes; I go with it.
I spread my arms and feel my way.
I squeeze through a crack, barely.

lines.zh: 我在水草边停下，歇一会。
lines.en: I pause by the weeds to rest.
My arms trail like strips of cloth.
I look up; the surface is far above.
I shift a little at a time.
I dislike light; I head for the dark.
My color fades with the water.

lines.zh: 我一伸一缩，贴着沙底挪。
lines.en: I stretch and contract, creeping over the sand.
I hover, arms swaying faintly.

lines.zh: 水里很静，我能听见远处。
lines.en: The water is still; I hear far off.

lines.zh: 我伏在石缝里，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie in the crevice, utterly still.
Without glow, I'm harder to see.
I rest against a stone, still.
My gills open and close slowly.
I wait for movement in the water.
This stretch of water is mine.
I tuck my arms beneath me.

lines.zh: 我很软，但也不容易抓住。
lines.en: Soft, but hard to hold.
The weeds sway above me.

lines.zh: 我把头转向水声的方向。
lines.en: I turn toward the sound of water.
Stillness beats motion.
Weeds brush me; I do not stir.
I float in the water before you.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水面上变形了。
lines.en: Your face is warped by the surface.

lines.zh: 我看不清你，但我知道你大。
lines.en: I can't see you clearly, but I know you're big.

lines.zh: 我把触腕伸向你的方向。
lines.en: I reach an arm toward you.
You reach in, and the water moves.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，只留一只眼。
lines.en: I slip into the crevice, one eye out.
I edge out a little.

lines.zh: 我隔着水纹打量你的手。
lines.en: I study your hands through the ripples.
There's no scent of you in the water.
I lift myself and consider you.
I ink the water and slip away in the murk.
My soft body is cut open.
I curl up to guard my gills.
Pain flattens me against the riverbed.
My scent is in the water now.
Pain pulls my arms in.
I bump into a stone.
I try a jet; I can still move.
I drag myself back into the dark.
I let out a small, ragged jet.
Something dropped into the water.

lines.zh: 有碎屑沉下来，我凑过去。
lines.en: Crumbs sink down; I drift over.
I circle halfway before reaching out.
I touch it with an arm first.
This isn't from the water.
I curl it up and bring it in.
Drop a little more and I'll come closer.
Two chews, then I spit it out.
I drag it into the dark.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我吃得更安心。
lines.en: Step back, and I'll eat easier.
The bump rolls me over.
My arms flail.
I hurry away.
My soft body flattens a little.
I jet water hard and back off.
That bump woke my caution.

lines.zh: 触腕缠住石头，我才停住。
lines.en: My arms catch a stone and I stop.
Don't come closer.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我挤进了石缝。
lines.en: The bump squeezes me into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我缩起触腕，从你旁边溜走。
lines.en: I draw my arms in and slip past you.

lines.zh: 同类在暗处，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Another of my kind in the dark; I feel it.
I touch it with an arm.

lines.zh: 两只鱿鱼在暗处交叠触腕。
lines.en: Two squid twine arms in the dark.
It's darker than I am.
We leave eggs in a rock crevice.
The current will tend them.

lines.zh: 之后我游回自己的水域。
lines.en: Then I swim back to my own water.
We needn't meet again.
This is how seaborn breed.
I sink to the bottom and go still.
I curl an arm around it.
It's slippery.
It takes two tries to grip it.
I curl my arms tight and swallow slowly.
This taste is unfamiliar.
I hide it in the weeds.
Too small to bother with.

lines.zh: 它卡在喉咙，我甩头吐掉。
lines.en: It sticks in my throat; I shake it loose.
This isn't food.
I curl it tight and keep it.
The current shifts; my arms lift.
I stop and draw my arms in.
It's larger than me.
I hide in the shadow first.
It's swimming over.
My ink is ready.
I fix on its gills.
I'll wait a little longer.
It's veering off.

lines.zh: 它转向石缝，我墨已备好。
lines.en: It turns toward the crevice; my ink is ready.
The ripples churn; it hasn't gone far.
I hold to the bottom.
If it comes close, I ink the water.
The water blackens; I've moved.
It's lost its heading.
I circle behind it.
I'm no fighter; I'm better at hiding.

lines.zh: 它转了两次都没找到我。
lines.en: It turns twice and can't find me.
I ink again.
It backs off; I ink and move.
I blast out black ink.
An arm whips out.
One bump and I withdraw.
I ink you across the face.
I strike with my rear fins.
I snag it for a moment.
I don't have the strength.
I can only slow it down.
It backs off; I sink down.
The water's black again.
I rise from the bottom.
The water is dark. Perfect.
I spread my arms and probe.
The water tastes of silt here.
I swim along the riverbed.
A rock crevice will do for cover.
I wedge myself in.
Only my eyes show.
Something is moving on the bank.
I won't move yet.

lines.zh: 水烫起来，我拼命往下沉。
lines.en: The water heats and I dive deep.
I hit the water and spread flat.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，吸不进东西。
lines.en: My gills work, and draw nothing.
The blast passes through the water and shoves me.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，扎中了我。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and finds me.
Light locks the water and I can't move.
Hunger leaves my arms strengthless.

lines.zh: 电流顺着水过来，我抽成一团。
lines.en: Current comes through the water; I curl tight.
The void is empty of even water.
